description:
Configure GeoServer WFS settings to optimize performance.

1. Configure the 'ne:ne_populated_places' layer to return a maximum of 50 features per request. This must be a layer-specific setting, NOT a global limit.
2. Configure the global WFS service settings to limit coordinate decimal precision to 3 places.

The GeoServer web admin is at http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/ (User: admin, Password: Admin123!).
